| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `move_to` | Move to the sector. |

| `cloak` | Switch the cloak on. |
| `decloak` | Switch the cloak off. |
| `sweep_mines` | Sweep the mines in the sector. |
| `use_component` | Use the component at position amount of the design. |
| `stellar_manipulation` | The manipulation numbered amount in stellar_action, on a target. |
| `move_to_waypoint` | Move to the waypoint in slot amount. |
| `self_destruct` | Destroy the whole vehicle or group. |
| `use_facility` | A colony's: use the facility at position amount. |
| `convert_resources` | A colony's: convert amount (at most 65,000) of one resource into another. |
| `scrap` | Scrap the vehicle (the Scrap window's command). |
| `analyze` | Take the vehicle apart to learn from it. |
| `mothball` | Mothball the vehicle. |
| `unmothball` | Bring it back into service. |
| `retrofit` | Refit to the design. |
| `fire_on` | Our armed ships destroy this vehicle. |
| `seek` | The computer's ministers' order: head for a sector, follow a vehicle or a planet, for one movement phase. |
| `join_fleet` | The ministers' order: follow the fleet whose id is amount and join it. |
